# GitHub issue templates

Use these titles even if the repo is still private.

## Dead link

```
URL:
Rail (Do / Parallel / Skim / Project / Focus):
HTTP status or error:
Station id if known:
```

## Wrong ranking

```
Station:
Current Do URL:
Proposed Do URL:
Scorecard (intuition, exercises, stack, depth):
```

## New station

```
Branch:
Why a new station vs Skim on an existing one:
Do / Parallel / Skim / Project URLs (all four required):
```
